154 THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

Boyd, was the parent magazine of the Baptist Standard, and that Professor Holland had his interest in it in the period from 1880, which came within one week of the close of the Savoy Female College period.

From the Baptist News of July 26, 1883, comes the information that the Baptist News, founded in December, 1886, at Honey Grove, was purchased in order by Professor Holland and J. H. Haines.

An appreciation of Holland as a teacher and his undoubted ability as a teacher, as well as his elevated position in the College during his period of service is given from The Savoy Star, as follows:
